prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good place to start is **ATA Martial Arts – St. Peters** if you’re looking for a traditional, structured program: it has a dedicated **ATA Tigers class for ages 4–6** and kids’ classes for older children. It’s at **6720 Mexico Rd**; call **(636) 556-5271** to check current class times and ask about its advertised six-week trial.

If your child is more interested in grappling and practical self-defense, consider **Onyx Grappling** at **953 Jungermann Rd**. It offers age-grouped kids’ Brazilian jiu-jitsu classes, including for younger children; call **(636) 339-4277** to ask about a free introductory class.

I’d visit or try a class at both before committing. Pay attention to how instructors manage the kids, whether beginners feel included, and whether the schedule and total cost work for your family. ([ATA St. Peters](https://www.atastpeters.com/), [Onyx Grappling](https://onyxgrappling.com/))
